summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects, but there are some concerns regarding functionality and testing.

issues.description: The implementation does not adjust the actual rendering of the text based on the antialiasing state set by set_antialiased. The current implementation only stores the state but does not use it during rendering.
There are no new tests added to verify the functionality of the new get/set_antialiased methods. Existing tests should be extended or new ones added to ensure the new methods work as expected.
The docstring for set_antialiased could be more descriptive, explaining what antialiasing means in the context of text rendering.
